rule: per-wave findings and design changes are recorded here with their reason; the forecast is not edited

built: codec_3_freeze.rs: the freeze file as the authority — acceptance.rule_binding read at run time (refuses a missing role, an undeclared arm, a symbol the inherited rule does not name, duplicate roles); bank 3 loaded against the digest the freeze names; the compressed-arm table; adjudicate_bound applies CODEC-2's unchanged adjudicate() to every bound arm and takes the verdict from the primary's alone

codec_3_freeze_arms.rs: per rung R → NULL → C (scores and logits under distinct names) → CH, CH-recent256, CH-recent128, each traced; residency (CODEC-1's equation for CH, the reconnaissance's mixed residency for the CH-recent arms) and the trace = CH's are stop guards; the record
codec_3_freeze_run.rs: W2's ignored entry point (LARQL_CODEC3_F32 / _Q4K / _RUN_DIR), four authorities
controls: the binding reads as frozen; four malformed bindings refused by name
the arm table equals the freeze's compressed arms, each running what its description states (bits, window)
bank 3 loads at the frozen digest; a freeze naming another bank is refused
secondary isolation both directions on hand-built strata: primary fails / secondary passes ⇒ NotAcceptable; primary passes / secondary fails ⇒ Acceptable
the trace and residency guards refuse seeded faults; executed: a window wider than declared stops the mixed-residency guard
the run module executed end to end on a three-rung fixture ladder: every arm, a resume that rewrites nothing, the record through the binding, traces equal to CH's and residency holding at every rung
executed at the call site: a resumed CH-recent arm whose recorded CH trace differs stops the run

a completed store is revalidated, not trusted: with every checkpoint left present, a corrupted CH trace, a recorded residency holds=false, and a stray beside holds=true each stop both the resume and the record; a stored residency is recomputed from its fields (strays required)
verification_of_controls: routing the verdict through the secondary instead of the primary turns the isolation control red

FOUND AND CLOSED: disabling the trace guard's call inside the run loop survived every control (on fixtures every trace equals CH's, so the record looked right). The executed call-site control above was added; the mutant is now caught
W1.known_limit: the residency guards' fresh-execution call sites are exercised only on providers that hold their declaration; the guards refuse seeded and executed faults, and every stored residency is re-checked from its fields on resume and before the record
W1.no_model_arm: no arm has run on bank 3
W1.review_fix: maintainer review of #657: on resume a present checkpoint skipped the trace and residency guards, and record() copied stored fields without re-checking them — a checkpoint's existence stood in for its guards. revalidate() now re-checks every stored compressed arm (residency recomputed from its recorded fields; each CH-recent trace against CH's stored trace) on resume and before the record. Removing either call site turns the new control red
